hotels.title: Vanuatu Private Island Escape with Secluded Beaches & an Overwater Spa
hotels.description: Ratua Private Island Resort sits on a 146-acre island off Espiritu Santo, where quiet beaches, coconut groves and a reef-fringed coastline set the scene for a slower Vanuatu escape. The over-water Coral Reef Spa and the Yacht Club, serving seasonal dishes made with island-grown produce and local seafood, bring the island’s natural setting into your stay. Snorkel the house reef, paddle the lagoon or cycle beneath the palms, then watch the light fade across the bay. Guided horse rides along the shoreline offer another way to explore this secluded corner of Vanuatu.
